Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Saturday Sunrise Ride

Chicago, IL · South Shore · Road

BIPOC

Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Saturday Sunrise Ride is a road group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls every Saturday at 5:30 am from La Rabida Children's Hospital parking lot. About 20–25 miles, 15–16 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at @majortaylorchi the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Major Taylor Cycling Club Chicago Saturday Sunrise Ride group ride

Saturday sunrise ride from the lakefront at La Rabida in South Shore. A bit quicker than the weekday Sunrise ride. The club's page lists 5:30 am; an older community listing said 6:00, so check the calendar.
